articles.title: 香港特区公司注册处2026年最新全面电子查册及穿透监管要点
articles.summary: 香港公司注册处最新合规指引正式生效，针对重要控制人登记册(SCR)及挂牌地址核查提出更高标准...
articles.content:
香港公司注册处于 2026 年起进一步收紧电子查册与重要控制人透明度要求。对已有香港公司的企业而言，这既是合规压力，也是一次把历史遗留问题清理干净的机会。

三个最需要关注的变化

  • 电子查册记录留痕——查册人身份与用途需登记，敏感资料的批量导出受到限制。
  • 重要控制人登记册（SCR）抽查常态化——注册办事处须备存最新 SCR，秘书公司会不定期核对。
  • 挂牌地址穿透核查——虚拟地址若无法联系到公司，可能被要求限期整改。

企业现在应该做的四件事

核对董事股东资料

确保护照/身份证件在有效期内，住址证明不超过 3 个月。

更新 SCR

股权转让、董事变更后 7 个工作日内更新重要控制人资料。

确认挂牌地址可达

确保信件有人签收，避免被注册处标记为失联。

整理业务佐证

合同、发票、网站与流水相互印证，应对银行年度复核。

合规不是成本，而是融资、上市与跨境结汇的通行证。永鸿国际可为存量香港公司提供 SCR 与挂牌地址的年度体检服务。

en.title: Hong Kong Companies Registry 2026: e-Search and look-through regulation explained
en.summary: The latest compliance guidance takes effect, raising the bar for the Significant Controllers Register and registered office checks...
en.content:
From 2026 the Companies Registry tightens electronic search records and beneficial-ownership transparency. For companies already established in Hong Kong this is both a compliance burden and a chance to clear historical issues.

Three changes that matter most

  • Search records are logged — searcher identity and purpose are registered, and bulk export of sensitive data is restricted.
  • SRC spot checks become routine — a current Significant Controllers Register must be kept at the registered office.
  • Registered office look-through — virtual addresses that cannot reach the company may face a rectification order.

Four things to do now

Verify director data

IDs and passports valid, proof of address under three months old.

Update the SRC

Update within seven working days of any share transfer or director change.

Confirm the office is reachable

Make sure post is collected so the Registry does not flag the entity.

Compile evidence

Contracts, invoices, website and statements that corroborate each other.

Compliance is not a cost — it is the passport to financing, listing and cross-border settlement. YONGHONG offers an annual SRC and registered-office health check.

articles.title: 2026年全球离岸银行开户风控白皮书：如何100%避开KYC审查雷区？
articles.summary: 各大外资银行对合规流水穿透审核加剧，本文由前外资银行合规经理为您揭秘视频见证必问的5大核心问题...
articles.content:
2026 年主要外资银行对跨境资金的穿透式审核明显收紧，开户被拒的主要原因已经从"资料不全"转向"资金来源解释不清"。

视频见证必问的 5 个问题

  1. 您的公司主要客户在哪些国家？单笔交易金额区间是多少？
  2. 资金来源是货款、服务费还是投资款？能否提供合同与发票？
  3. 预计每月收支笔数与金额？是否有大额一次性交易？
  4. 是否有实质经营活动（办公室、员工、网站）？
  5. 最终受益人是谁？股权结构是否有代持？

被拒率最高的三类情形

行业敏感

加密货币、博彩、贵金属、军民两用等需提前准备专项说明。

流水异常

个人账户与公司账户混用、频繁大额整数进出。

资料矛盾

网站、合同、发票与流水对不上，是面签最容易翻车的点。

应对方案

提前做 KYC 预审 + 面签模拟，是我们通过率 98.6% 的关键。

提示：切勿听信"包过"话术。合规的开户辅导是把您的真实经营讲清楚，而不是编造故事。

en.title: 2026 Global Offshore Banking KYC Whitepaper: how to clear screening
en.summary: Banks now audit cross-border flows far more aggressively. A former compliance manager reveals the five questions asked in every video interview...
en.content:
In 2026 the major foreign banks tightened look-through review of cross-border funds. Rejections now stem less from missing paperwork and more from an unconvincing source of wealth.

The five questions asked in every interview

  1. Which countries are your customers in, and what is the typical transaction size?
  2. Is the money from goods, services or investment? Can you show contracts and invoices?
  3. What monthly volume do you expect? Any large one-off transactions?
  4. Is there real substance — office, staff, website?
  5. Who are the ultimate beneficial owners? Any nominee holdings?

Three situations with the highest rejection rate

Sensitive industries

Crypto, gambling, precious metals and dual-use goods need a pre-written explanation.

Abnormal flows

Mixing personal and corporate accounts, frequent round-number transfers.

Contradictory files

Website, contracts, invoices and statements that do not line up.

The fix

Pre-audit plus a mock interview — the reason our approval rate is 98.6%.

A warning: ignore anyone promising a guaranteed account. Proper coaching tells your real business story — it does not invent one.

articles.title: 香港公司离岸免税申请(Offshore Claim)实操案例与合规风险防范
articles.summary: 离岸所得免税并非“零申报”！税务局对无保留意见审计报告的抽查率大幅上升，企业应如何建立合规证据链...
articles.content:
很多企业误以为"公司在香港没有办公室 = 可以零申报"。实际上，离岸所得免税（Offshore Claim）需要在审计报告中给出充分依据，由税务局个案审批。

税务局重点看什么

  • 合同签署地与履约地在哪里
  • 货物的实际运输路径与报关记录
  • 决策与管理是否在香港境内发生
  • 收款账户所在地与资金流向

实操案例

某跨境电商企业 2024 年申请离岸免税，因无法提供与境外供应商的完整物流单证，被要求补充资料并最终按 80% 核定。整改后我们协助补齐了合同、提单与邮件决策记录，2025 年获批全额离岸豁免。

证据链四件套

合同 + 物流单证 + 决策邮件 + 收付款凭证，缺一不可。

时间线要闭合

合同日期、发货日期、收款日期必须能串成合理顺序。

切忌账外账

两套账一旦被穿透，后续三年都会成为重点抽查对象。

年度复盘

每年报税前做一次离岸证据链自查，比事后补救省十倍。

离岸免税是合法权利，但不是默认结果。把证据做在平时，才是最稳的筹划。

en.title: Hong Kong offshore claim: worked example and compliance risks
en.summary: An offshore claim is not a nil filing. With audit sampling rising sharply, how should a company build its evidence chain?
en.content:
Many firms assume that having no office in Hong Kong means a nil filing. In fact an offshore claim must be substantiated inside the audit report and is approved case by case by the IRD.

What the IRD examines

  • Where the contract was signed and performed
  • The actual routing of goods and customs records
  • Whether decision-making and management happened in Hong Kong
  • Where the receiving account sits and how funds moved

A worked example

A cross-border e-commerce company claimed offshore status for 2024 but could not produce complete logistics documents; the claim was settled at 80%. After we supplied contracts, bills of lading and decision emails, the 2025 claim was approved in full.

The four pillars

Contract, logistics documents, decision emails, payment records.

Close the timeline

Contract, shipment and payment dates must form a plausible sequence.

No shadow accounts

Once two sets of books are found, three years become a target.

Annual review

A pre-filing self-check is ten times cheaper than correcting it afterwards.

An offshore claim is a right, not a default outcome. Build the evidence throughout the year — that is the safest planning.

articles.title: 隐私政策
articles.summary: 我们如何收集、使用、存储与保护您的个人信息，以及您享有的权利。
articles.content:
版本号：v1.0　·　生效日期：2026-01-01

本政策适用于永鸿国际咨询（深圳）有限公司（以下简称"我们"）官方网站及在线咨询服务。您在提交咨询表单前，必须勾选"我已阅读并同意《隐私政策》"，我们将在服务器记录您的同意时间与本政策版本号作为同意凭证。

一、我们收集哪些信息

您主动提供的

称呼、联系电话、微信/邮箱、公司名称、需求描述。

自动采集的

IP 地址、浏览器与设备标识、来路页面、UTM 营销参数、访问日志。

二、我们如何使用这些信息

  • 用于与您取得联系并提供您所咨询的业务方案与报价；
  • 用于履行法律法规要求的客户尽职调查（KYC）义务；
  • 用于改进网站内容与服务体验（去标识化统计）；
  • 我们不会向任何第三方出售您的个人信息。

三、存储与保护

个人信息存储于中华人民共和国境内的服务器，保存期限为实现处理目的所必要的最短时间，一般为自最后一次联系起 3 年。我们采取传输加密、后台权限分级、列表脱敏（手机号默认显示为 138****8000）等措施。

四、您享有的权利

查阅与复制

您有权查阅、复制我们持有的您的个人信息。

更正与补充

信息有误时可要求更正。

删除

在法定情形下可要求删除。

撤回同意

您可随时撤回同意，撤回不影响此前处理的效力。

五、联系我们

如对本政策有任何疑问，或行使上述权利，请发送邮件至 805856285@qq.com，或致电 18123763835。我们将在 15 个工作日内答复。

六、政策更新

本政策发生实质变更时，我们将提升版本号并在本页公示。新的版本号将用于后续新的同意记录，历史同意凭证仍对应当时的版本。

Withdraw at any time without affecting prior processing.

Material changes raise the version number and are published on this page. New consent records reference the new version; historical evidence still points to the version accepted at the time.

services.title: 香港审计报税

services.summary: 代理香港公司财税审计怎么做最省心？香港持牌执业会计师(CPA)，让永鸿来为您“金”打细算。
services.content:
香港利得税报税分两个阶段：收到报税表后需在 1 个月内提交；首年可申请延期至 3 个月。所有香港公司每年均须由执业会计师出具审计报告。

服务范围

做账

整理银行流水、单据与合同，按香港准则编制财务报表。

审计

由执业会计师出具无保留意见 / 保留意见审计报告。

报税

填报利得税报税表，申请两级制与离岸豁免。

税务筹划

结合 BEPS 2.0 与离岸所得免税，制定合规节税路径。

离岸所得免税并非“零申报”——税务局对无保留意见报告的抽查率正在上升，务必保留完整证据链。

en.summary: Let licensed practising accountants (CPA) handle your Hong Kong bookkeeping and audit down to the last penny.
en.content:
Hong Kong profits tax runs in two stages: the return must be filed within one month of receipt (extendable to three for the first year), and every company needs an audit report from a practising accountant each year.

Scope

Bookkeeping

Bank statements, vouchers and contracts compiled under HK standards.

Audit

Unqualified or qualified opinion issued by a practising accountant.

Filing

Profits tax return prepared; two-tier and offshore claims applied.

Tax planning

Compliant structuring around BEPS 2.0 and offshore exemption.

An offshore claim is not a nil filing — the IRD audits far more frequently, so keep a complete evidence chain.

en.title: Hong Kong Company Deregistration
en.summary: Compliant deregistration avoids heavy government penalties — settle accounts and tax, then strike off or transfer.
en.content:
An idle Hong Kong company still owes annual returns and business registration fees; penalties accumulate and the director's credit record suffers.

Two ways out

Deregistration

For companies with no outstanding liabilities — approved jointly by the IRD and the CR in about 5–6 months.

Winding up

For companies with debts or assets; requires a liquidator and a stricter process.

Prerequisites

  • The company never traded, or ceased trading more than 3 months ago
  • All tax returns are filed and no tax remains unpaid
  • No pending legal proceedings or liabilities
en.seo_description: One-stop Hong Kong deregistration and winding up — avoid penalties and close cleanly.
